results.title: El Día Que Me Quieras
results.overview: In a near-future Los Angeles where space travel is becoming common, a young couple faces their last day together after Lisa is selected by NASA for a life-changing mission. Torn between love and ambition, they try to make peace with the distance her choice will create.

results.title: Effeuillage
results.overview: After a very difficult life ordeal, Céline and Christian meet again for the first time around an erotic game they have been practicing for a long time.

results.title: Manhunt
results.overview: Inspired by the real 2019 Northern British Columbia manhunt when two teenage boys from Vancouver Island murdered three strangers and fled north through ghost towns and endless forest. Their flight, live-tracked across social media and news feeds, unfolded like a fever dream of the digital age: an openworld simulation of fear and fascination. Weeks later, their bodies were found by a river, the chase ending as abruptly as it began.

results.title: Sunshine Girls
results.overview: SUNSHINE GIRLS follows the story of Elaine, a timid woman nearing her 30th birthday who must make the difficult choice between motherhood and medically induced photosynthesis.  After prolonged environmental destruction, Elaine’s world is experiencing a dangerous shortage of oxygen.  Science has created a solution to this problem: a “minimally invasive” medical procedure that allows women’s reproductive systems to host photosynthesis and cellular respiration, ultimately enabling them to give birth to air.  For the first time in her life, amongst the ragtag troupe of oxygen-producing misfits called the Sunshine Girls, Elaine finally begins to grow into the woman she has always wanted to be...but not everything is always as bright and sunny as it seems.

results.title: This Is Birmingham
results.overview: When Birmingham crime boss Al Kaleo is jailed for murder, his estranged son AK steps up to prove himself. But as he rises, a ruthless Turkish gang from London floods the city with a deadly new drug, igniting a brutal turf war. With chaos on the streets, AK faces a fight not just for control-but for the soul of the city and everything he stands for.

results.title: Dhabkaaro
results.overview: An extremely inhuman, cruel, rude, and dishonest man named Ashok Patel embarks on a quest for forgiveness to reconcile with his past.

results.title: Haron
results.overview: The protagonist has passed through prison, the catwalk, and the funeral business to become the living embodiment of Charon. He is a guide who assists others in crossing the main river, while also finding his own shore.

results.title: The Damned Thing
results.overview: A coroner’s inquest into an inexplicable death reveals the presence of an enigmatic creature.

results.title: Ayreon: 30th Anniversary - An Amazing Flight Through Time
results.original_title: Ayreon: 30th Anniversary - An Amazing Flight Through Time
results.overview: A grand, theatrical live concert film capturing Ayreon's 30th Anniversary spectacle at the 013 in Tilburg, featuring a three-decade-spanning setlist of Ayreon favourites and deep cuts, an all-star cast of vocalists and musicians, elaborate stage design, cinematic visuals and special effects that transform the performance into an immersive sci‑fi musical experience.

results.title: The Act of Cutting Away
results.overview: Insurmountable medical bureaucracy pushes Roland, a transmasculine college student, to the absolute brink. Desperate for top surgery but blocked by systemic gatekeeping, his reality fractures when he discovers a classmate running a clandestine, illegal dissection operation. What started as a struggle against healthcare politics instantly devolves into a grim, body-horror bargain for survival.

results.title: Dynamo
results.overview: Rocky, a second year student plans a wild dance to impress the whole college. Rajahuli, the dominant final year student, sees this as a challenge to his authority. A fierce clash brews between Rocky's ambition and Rajahuli's control.

results.title: How to Fast Train Your Furious Dragon
results.original_title: How to Fast Train Your Furious Dragon
results.overview: The dream chasers race nitro-injected street cars and join forces with dragon rider Hiccup in the wildest cross-over ever dreamed up as 'DREAMZzz', 'The Fast and the Furious' and 'How to train your Dragon' collide head on. But the Nightmare King is always scheming and plans to corrupt the friendly dragons of Berk, and our heroes soon find themselves in a desperate race to save the Dream World.

results.title: The White Ibis
results.overview: At an illustrious restaurant, a disrespected new employee must deliver a prized sandwich on foot to keep their job and test their mettle.

results.title: The Counselor
results.overview: A young, inexperienced, counselor tries to prevent a grief-stricken student from carrying out an act of violence after her best friend is shot to death.

results.title: Little Lamb
results.overview: After her parents' death, Lily moves into the vacation home they left for her and discovers she's far from alone.

results.title: Visa pa'l mundial
results.overview: The story follows the adventures of various characters in their desperate attempt to obtain a "visa" or the necessary means to accompany the team to the World Cup.

results.title: Harbinger
results.overview: Julia, sole survivor of late serial killer Decker, is lured back to the house she shared with him for a ghost hunting TV show. The crew discover the 'Harbinger' - a fairground fortune telling machine that reveals their fates one by one.

results.title: Fantasy Life
results.overview: An anxious New York law school dropout stumbles into a job babysitting his psychiatrist's three granddaughters and falls for the girls' mother, an actress in a rocky marriage.
